zh.title: 關於我
zh.intro: 畢業於臺藝大新媒體藝術碩士，專注於全端網頁開發與即時互動應用。
zh.heading: 核心專長與專業定位
zh.p1: 我是許哲誠，具備機械製圖底子、次世代 3D 美術管線與軟體工程的跨領域背景。專注於 Unity (C#) 客戶端架構設計，堅持高內聚、低耦合與模組解耦原則，熟練運用狀態機模式、事件驅動架構與運行期零 GC 物件池調校。同時具備全端通訊與關聯式資料庫整合視野，能無障礙銜接機構硬體、3D 美術資產與後端系統，致力於打造兼具流暢運行效能與高維護性的互動產品。

bio.title: 個人自傳
bio.p1_title: 工程基礎與跨領域積累
bio.p1: 具備紮實的工程邏輯與數位資產整合實力。大學期間主導開發動作射擊遊戲《滅境之星》，奪得專題競賽第一名；連續三年擔任專任研發助理，主導《飛機檢修行動學習平臺》等三項產學互動系統，深入負責介面切版、事件監聽與流程控制。於樂美館參與商業遊戲次世代 3D 外包，熟練掌握 PBR 製程，具備嚴格控管模型面數預算與 Draw Call 的美術視野。
bio.p2_title: Unity 客戶端架構與效能調校
bio.p2: 碩士期間深耕 Unity (C#) 客戶端研發，堅持高內聚、低耦合的架構原則。在 2D 節奏跑酷專案《節奏同奏》中，實作純 C# 有限狀態機徹底消滅動畫過渡衝突，並以泛型物件池循環複用高頻物件，有效降低運行期記憶體配置與 GC 卡頓；於 VR 解謎專案《覺醒協議》中深度客製空間抓取與插槽機制，並自研純數學正弦插值取代高耗能狀態機評估，有效降低 CPU 負載，確保 VR 空間維持高度流暢。
bio.p3_title: 全端通訊視野與團隊協作
bio.p3: 兼具全端架構與軟體工程思維，能運用後端 API 打通前後端通訊，建立完整的 Client-Server 與資料庫整合視野。在開發流程中深度整合版本控制與現代 AI 協作流程，能高效進行模組設計、邏輯排查與快速交付，致力為團隊打造兼具優秀效能與穩定可維護性的互動產品。

en.title: About
en.intro: M.A. graduate in New Media Art, focusing on full-stack web development and real-time interactive applications.
en.heading: Core Competencies & Professional Specialization
en.p1: I am Che-Cheng Hsu, bringing an interdisciplinary background across mechanical drafting, next-gen 3D art pipelines, and software engineering. I specialize in Unity (C#) client architecture design, adhering to high-cohesion, loose-coupling, and modular decoupling principles, proficient in finite state machines, event-driven architectures, and zero-GC object pool optimization. Concurrently equipped with fullstack communication and relational database integration vision, I seamlessly bridge hardware mechanisms, 3D artistic assets, and backend systems to deliver high-performance, maintainable interactive products.

bio.title: Personal Biography
bio.p1: Equipped with solid engineering logic and digital asset integration expertise. During undergraduate studies, led the development of action shooter Planet of Extinction, winning 1st place in the National Special Topic Competition; served as a full-time research assistant for 3 consecutive years, directing 3 industry-academia interactive systems such as Aircraft Maintenance Mobile Learning Platform, taking charge of UI layout, event listening, and state flow control. Participated in commercial next-gen 3D AAA outsourcing at XPEC Art Center, mastering PBR workflows with strict polygon and Draw Call budget control.
bio.p2: Dedicated to Unity (C#) client engineering during master's studies, adhering to high cohesion and low coupling architectural principles. In 2D rhythm runner Ensemble Rhythm, implemented pure C# finite state machines to eliminate animation transition conflicts, utilizing generic object pools to recycle high-frequency objects, effectively minimizing runtime memory allocations and GC lag; in VR puzzle project Awakening Protocol, deeply customized spatial grab and socket mechanics, developing sinusoidal mathematical interpolation to replace heavy state evaluations, cutting CPU overhead and ensuring smooth VR experiences.
bio.p3: Combining fullstack architecture with software engineering rigor, proficient in connecting frontend-backend communications via RESTful APIs, establishing comprehensive Client-Server and database integration perspectives. Deeply integrating modern version control and AI-assisted workflows into the development lifecycle, facilitating efficient module design, systematic debugging, and agile delivery to build high-performance, maintainable interactive products.
